mapper.select: select consent_id,member_id,consent_type,consent_version,consent_ip,consent_time from mall_member_consent where member_id=#{memberId} order by consent_time desc,consent_id desc

select event_type,title,summary,event_time from ( select 'SESSION_LOGIN' event_type,'设备登录' title, concat(d.device_name,' · ',coalesce(s.login_ip,'未知网络')) summary,s.create_time event_time from mall_member_session s join mall_member_device d on d.member_device_id=s.member_device_id where s.member_id=#{memberId} union all select 'CONSENT_CONFIRMED', case when c.consent_type='USER_AGREEMENT' then '确认用户协议' else '确认隐私政策' end, concat('版本 ',c.consent_version,' · 服务必需授权'),c.consent_time from mall_member_consent c where c.member_id=#{memberId} union all select 'ACCOUNT_CREATED','账号创建','手机号验证注册',m.create_time from mall_member m where m.member_id=#{memberId} and m.del_flag='0' union all select a.event_type,a.title,a.summary,a.create_time from mall_member_lifecycle_audit a where a.member_id=#{memberId} ) lifecycle order by event_time desc limit 50
select count(1) from mall_member_session where member_id=#{memberId} and status='ACTIVE' and expire_time>now()
select * from mall_member_phone_change_request where request_id=#{requestId} and member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.update: update mall_member_phone_change_request set status='NEW_PHONE_PENDING',old_verified_time=now(),update_time=now() where request_id=#{requestId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status='OLD_PHONE_PENDING' and expires_time>now()

update mall_member_phone_change_request set status='COMPLETED',new_verified_time=now(),completed_time=now(),update_time=now() where request_id=#{requestId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status='NEW_PHONE_PENDING' and expires_time>now()
mapper.select: select * from mall_member_account_action_ticket where ticket_hash=#{ticketHash} and request_id=#{requestId} and member_id=#{memberId} and consumed_time is null and expire_time>now()
mapper.update: update mall_member_account_action_ticket set consumed_time=now() where ticket_id=#{ticketId} and consumed_time is null
